items.title: Snake-Game-Reinforcement-Project
items.summary: A self-taught Snake agent built with Deep Q-Learning, PyTorch, and Pygame. No hand-coded strategy — the snake starts out clueless and learns entirely through trial and error, reward by reward, game by game.
items.summary_cn: 使用Deep Q-Learning、PyTorch和Pygame构建的自学Snake代理。没有手工编码的策略—蛇一开始一无所知，完全通过试错、奖励奖励、游戏来学习。
items.comment: AI 领域新动态，保持关注，别被营销号带节奏。

items.title: PNOE’s new face mask wants to make lab-grade breath testing a self-serve affair
items.title_cn: PNOE的新口罩希望使实验室级呼吸测试成为自助服务
items.summary: PNOĒ, the Malden, Mass.-based startup whose breath-analyzing mask used to bear an unfortunate resemblance to Bane's, is launching a sleeker self-serve version on October 1 that lets gym-goers measure their VO₂ max and other metabolic markers in eight minutes without a trained operator.
items.summary_cn: 总部位于马萨诸塞州莫尔登的初创公司PNO ，其呼吸分析面罩曾经与贝恩的呼吸分析面罩有着不幸的相似之处，将于10月1日推出更时尚的自助服务版本，让健身爱好者在没有训练有素的操作员的情况下，在8分钟内测量他们的VO ₂ max和其他代谢标志物。
items.comment: 又是一个「史上最强」，基准测试刷得飞起，实际应用场景待检验。

items.summary: The limited test covers select products and users, with a broader rollout planned for later in October.
items.summary_cn: 有限的测试涵盖部分产品和用户，并计划于10月下旬进行更广泛的推广。
